name: M101 (Pinwheel Galaxy)

target.name: M101 (Pinwheel Galaxy)
target.blurb: Galaxia espiral: un campo de control estático.
target.why: Nada debería moverse aquí. Sirve para calibrar qué parece cambio y no lo es.

en.blurb: Spiral galaxy: a static control field.
en.why: Nothing should move here. Calibrates what looks like change but is not.

expected.basis: Extended galaxy; static reference field (the existing /frames demo)

position.method: astropy SkyCoord.apply_space_motion (PM + parallax distance; RV if known, else 0)

catalog.query: SELECT b.main_id,b.ra,b.dec,b.coo_bibcode,b.pmra,b.pmdec,b.pm_bibcode,b.plx_value,b.plx_bibcode,b.rvz_radvel,b.otype FROM basic AS b JOIN ident AS i ON i.oidref=b.oid WHERE i.id='M 101'

wcs.pixel_convention: 1-based FITS pixel centres; x = column (0 = East edge), y = row (0 = North edge) of the delivered array

pixel_encoding.pixels_b64: little-endian float32, n*n, row-major, row 0 = North, column 0 = East; unit MJy/sr; NaN = no usable measurement
pixel_encoding.flags_b64: little-endian uint32 SPHEREx FLAGS bitmask (nearest native pixel), same orientation; see frame.flag_bits
pixel_encoding.nan_policy: NaN where outside the frame footprint, non-finite, variance <= 0 or flagged ['COLD', 'DICHROIC', 'HOT', 'MISSING_DATA', 'NONFUNC', 'PHANMISS']; all other flags are kept and reported

provenance.citation: This publication makes use of data products from the Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization and Ices Explorer (SPHEREx), which is a joint project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the California Institute of Technology, and is funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. Data retrieved from NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA).
provenance.selection: deterministic time-uniform sample per detector, round-robin across detectors
provenance.transfer: HTTP byte ranges on AWS mirror s3://nasa-irsa-spherex (fallback: IRSA cutout service)
limitations: Each SPHEREx frame samples a source at ONE wavelength (linear variable filter); brightness changes between frames can be colour, not time variability.
Pixels are reprojected with bilinear interpolation; no PSF homogenisation.
lambda_um/bandwidth_um come from the approximate spectral WCS 'W' at the request centre.
Images include zodiacal light (ZODI extension not subtracted).
Quality flags are reported, not hidden; only hard-invalid bits are NaN-masked.

caveats: Predicted positions from Gaia DR3 astrometry (epoch J2016.0); not SPHEREx detections.
Gaia covariances are not propagated; per-epoch errors combine catalog sigmas in quadrature.
Missing radial velocity is assumed 0 km/s.
Geocentric annual parallax included; aberration not applied (astrometric place).
Gaia is incomplete for very red, faint objects (e.g. Y dwarfs such as WISE 0855).

provenance.citation: Gaia Collaboration, Vallenari et al. 2023, A&A 674, A1 (Gaia DR3); ESA Gaia Archive https://gea.esac.esa.int/archive/
provenance.adql: SELECT TOP 2000 source_id, ra, dec, ra_error, dec_error, ref_epoch, pmra, pmdec, pmra_error, pmdec_error, parallax, parallax_error, radial_velocity, phot_g_mean_mag, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 210.80242917, 54.34875000, 0.05833333)) OR (pm > 2863.479 AND 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 210.80242917, 54.34875000, 0.08055723))) ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC

caveats_es: Preferencia relativa entre un conjunto pequeño de plantillas; la clase real puede no estar entre ellas.
Se combinan puntos de distintas épocas: la variabilidad o el movimiento distorsionan el espectro.
Las plantillas estelares son cuerpos negros idealizados, no atmósferas estelares.
El modelo de asteroide es simplificado (luz reflejada a 5778 K + cuerpo negro térmico).
Se suma en cuadratura un error de calibración fraccional del 3% (supuesto).
15 punto(s) excluido(s) (saturados, con marcas de artefacto o sin medir).
12 punto(s) sin corrección de apertura EPSF excluido(s) (flujo de apertura, no total; sesgaría el ajuste).
La fuente no se detecta de forma significativa en esta posición: 0 punto(s) utilizable(s) con S/N ≥ 3 en 0 detector(es); la clasificación necesita ≥ 6 en ≥ 3 detectores. Sin clasificación.
classification.method_es: chi² a plantillas con ajuste de escala
